我开心的一天(My Happy Day): 说话者用简单英语介绍自己的一天与喜好。
We often go to the park together.
I like my life very much.
I go to the park every Saturday.
I often play basketball after class.
Ben often helps me with math.
My friend Ben is very kind.
There's a new film at the cinema.
column3: 电影院有一部新片上映。
